title: A Conditional Reduction for Algebraic Kuga–Satake Correspondences
main_claim: For a polarized K3 surface with Hg(V)=SO(V,q), three conditions are equivalent: (i) some algebraic correspondence gives a nonzero map V→H^2(B) for an abelian variety B; (ii) some generically finite surface cover Y→S has a nonzero trace of wedges of 1-forms; (iii) the prescribed full Kuga–Satake map is algebraic. If (i) or (ii) holds very generally in a polarized component, then the prescribed KS correspondence (with any standard data on T(S)) is algebraic at every point of that component.
coverage: Read all sections in full. Checked: (ii)⇒(i) via Albanese, the projection-formula nonvanishing, and the E^2 degree adjustment (codimension and twist bookkeeping: E^2 acts H^{2b-2}→H^2, composite has codim 2). Checked (i)⇒(ii) via the cycle α·ℓ^{c-2} and Hodge–Riemann (H^{2,0} classes are automatically primitive). Checked the generic Hodge group argument (bivector spanning, countable union). Checked the joint group decomposition g⊕k, including that k acts trivially on W^± through the spin image. Checked the weight-one constraint: the extreme eigenvalue gap is 4λ1≤2, so only trivial or spin constituents occur, with D'=0 on the spin part. Hodge maps U→W^± are exactly the g-maps. Checked that the vector multiplicity in Δ⊗Δ=⊕Λ^{even}V is one (sign-change argument leaves only k=0 and k=20). Checked that the independent slot operations span N1⊗N2, followed by rational descent. Checked Hilbert-scheme specialization: analytic classifying map, flat top-cycle classes being flat sections, countably many proper components with Remmert images, and the Baire choice of a point. Checked the primitive projector formula. Checked restriction to T via the inclusion/retraction identity p L_x i = L_x. Checked the polarization change: R_s is q0-self-adjoint with R_s^2=P, so it is an isometry q1→q0. The connected-lift μ2 argument gives F_s equivariance. Verified the conjugation identity F^{-1}L_x F = L_{R^{-1}x} and the sign-average formula p_i = ν_i 2^{-r} Σ_s s_i R_s^{-1}. Checked the final assembly and the corollary on primitive ample classes. Sibling notes for family 032 had no shared lemma that this paper depends on.
sibling_notes: Self-contained. It does not rely on the family-032 companion papers (Weil classes, K3 quadratic locus, CM HC, abelian covers), so no circularity. The existence of the initial correspondence remains an explicit hypothesis, and the paper says so honestly.
